description: Source code for an Android ListActivity 'List6' demonstrating custom list adapter and view logic with speech data.

classes.name: List6
classes.description: A ListActivity subclass displaying a list of speeches with expandable dialogue using a custom adapter.

classes.name: SpeechListAdapter
classes.description: A custom BaseAdapter managing a list of speech titles and dialogues with toggle expand/collapse feature.

classes.name: SpeechView
classes.description: A custom LinearLayout view representing each speech item with title and dialogue, which can be expanded or collapsed.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the ListActivity and sets a custom adapter.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles click events to toggle expansion of the selected speech.

methods.name: SpeechListAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing context and data arrays.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of speech items.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the position as the data item (placeholder).

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses SpeechView, updates content based on position.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the expanded state of a specific list item and refreshes the view.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title for a SpeechView.

methods.name: setDialogue
methods.description: Sets the dialogue text for a SpeechView.

methods.name: setExpanded
methods.description: Expands or collapses the dialogue section of a SpeechView.
